pmd_decision.trigger: Document Stream-K did not improve the correct local full-operator cold time

baseline.normalization_scope: Logical full-GEMM work only; excludes padded work and scratch traffic. Use complete multi-dispatch operator time for final comparisons.

suggested-streamk.normalization_scope: Logical full-GEMM work only; excludes padded work and scratch traffic. Use complete multi-dispatch operator time for final comparisons.

pmd_decision.interpretation: M=5684 has 23 physical rows of 256 with a 52-row tail; N=4096 and K=4608 are aligned. Baseline 368 tiles assign 3 or 4 per CU; narrow 736 tiles assign 7 or 8. Both geometric wave efficiencies remain 0.95833. Narrow tests actual pipeline/issue costs and finer tile granularity, without assuming an aggregate wave-efficiency gain. Tail-store tests a separate epilogue consequence: baseline uses masked vector stores on every row because M is not divisible by 256; use native matrix stores for complete 128-row consumer panels and retain exact masks for the final partial panel.

followups.name: pmd-narrow256x128
followups.hypothesis: Actual per-CU MMOP imbalance triggers 256x128 whole tiles. Keep cluster2 double-buffered persistent pipeline and remove Stream-K reset/scratch/merge. Both original and narrow geometric efficiencies are 0.95833; measure actual MMOP and issue/barrier changes plus complete latency.

followups.name: pmd-group4
followups.hypothesis: Nonzero actual wait/issue/barrier counters plus UMC requests trigger B-panel reuse by grouping four M tiles. Keep baseline 256x256/cluster2 and exact 23-row coverage including final group of 3; aggregate arithmetic balance is unchanged.

followups.name: pmd-tail-store
followups.hypothesis: Actual vector-memory/store instructions plus the 52-row M tail trigger per-consumer panel store specialization. Full 128-row panels use native matrix_store; the single partial panel retains masked gl.store. Keep baseline tile/order/load/compute pipeline and require full-output oracle and direct baseline validation.
